ops.old: Dark chocolate and salted caramel ganache rolled into truffles, coated in cocoa and crushed honeycomb, packed in a little gift box with a bow. Heat 150ml cream until steaming and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate. Stir until smooth, then mix in 3 tbsp thick caramel and a good pinch of sea salt. Chill 3 hours until firm. Roll into 24 balls with cool hands, then coat half in cocoa and half in 60g crushed honeycomb. Pack into a small box lined with baking paper and tie with a bow.
